laws.rule: National park entry (general rate, which applies to foreign visitors), daily pass from 1 June 2026: Talampaya ARS 25,000. Children 0 to 6 free. Flexipass 3- and 7-day passes are also sold. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS: ARS 25,000 ≈ A$23.19)

layers.process: Talampaya National Park can't be visited on your own. You must take an excursion. The excursion 'Naturaleza y Cultura de Talampaya' is included with the entry ticket and has two fixed daily departures, 9:00 and 16:00, with limited places. Tickets can be bought online or at the park; in-person entry payment is cash or debit card only, and concessionaire excursions can be paid by credit or debit card. The daily entry fee is already held under this province's local law.
